name: giving-path
label: Giving path row
description: One way to give: a heading and short summary on the left; on the right an intro, a button, a note, more text, and an optional list of things to fund, each with its own button.

defaults.heading: Give where it’s needed most
defaults.intro: Give once, or give monthly. Monthly gifts are how we keep showing up.
defaults.note: You will finish on our giving page at Zeffy. You can choose one time or monthly there.
defaults.summary: Our work is much more than a handout. A direct gift keeps case management going: housing assessments, resource navigation, referrals, warm handoffs, benefits enrollment, peer support and advocacy.
